comments.author: @ChrisGaynor12
comments.text: This video is excellent. I am considering travelling to OKINAWA. I wish there was the kind of community that exists there, that does not always happen in the UK. A lot of the time in the UK, there is unrest and standards have dropped considerably. There is a lack of "real" community in the UK - and to me it seems OKINAWA is the standard that a lot of countries need to meet in the West...Great commentary on what the culrure is like...

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: Yes, the community here is truly special.
